pos.personaBrief: Deschamps does not worry about possession and sits back to counter (Irish Examiner 2022, Gulf News 2018); Capello's Milan soaked up pressure and shut up shop after scoring.

pro.personaBrief: France strike in the blink of an eye on the counter with Mbappe; Capello kept a safe defensive midfielder and Deschamps builds from deep but not unnecessarily.

est.personaBrief: Capello's Milan kept the disciplined 4-4-2 base and Scolari insisted on tactical discipline; shapes were set by squad, with defined roles and little tight-space combination play.

lar.personaBrief: Capello narrowed Milan's midfield for the defensive structure and Deschamps favours power in midfield, while Scolari's wing-backs Cafu and Roberto Carlos provided width; a mixed, central-leaning picture.

blo.personaBrief: Capello's Milan dropped off and waited, Deschamps' France absorb pressure and defend in numbers; the full-pitch press was abandoned.

mar.personaBrief: Marking is not verified in the sources; Capello's zonal base from Sacchi and adaptation to opponents suggest a zonal lean with pragmatic exceptions.

pla.personaBrief: Capello changed system by squad and club, Scolari switched shape match by match, Deschamps says adapting is the key quality; no fixed identity.

res.personaBrief: Deschamps' master word is winning, Capello's Milan 1993/94 had eight 0-0s and nine 1-0s, and Capello shrugged off Cruyff's taunts about boring football.

sis.personaBrief: Capello marginalised Savicevic for discipline and Deschamps got flair players like Pogba to defend; the collective and duties come before the star.

jog.personaBrief: Capello always had a strong defensive midfielder and Deschamps picked athletic power in midfield, with the team above flair; physical, athletic profiles prioritised.

bas.personaBrief: Deschamps picked a group for going far, favouring experienced players like Giroud and Matuidi when the plan faltered; Capello and Scolari built with proven, established players.

lid.personaBrief: Scolari dropped Romario despite popular pressure, Deschamps left out Benzema because the team is above everything, and Capello fell out with stars over discipline.
